THE_1x_ABSENT_LINK_CONFIRMED_INDEPENDENT.meaning: at FULL POOL the switch moves ZERO decisions on this base, reproducing what cf_pd_proofs.json already declared as an ABSENT LINK (Rule 2 unexercised) rather than as a negative. A rung-4 cell list at 1x would therefore be a GUARANTEED NULL: four live cells spent to rediscover a documented absent link. That is why these cells carry _kv0.25 IN THE TAG, so the memory setting cannot be lost from the cell name.

THE_CAVEAT_THAT_BOUNDS_WHAT_THIS_CAN_CLA: _kv0.25 changes the HARNESS'S LOGICAL POOL only: the coordinator's belief plus enforcement at --gpu-kv-tokens 15736 (study_frozen_grid_driver_v28.sh:85), with --kv-capacity-enforced. THE ENGINE'S REAL vLLM ALLOCATION IS PINNED AND UNCHANGED. Protect-and-defer acts on the coordinator's pool, so it should fire live as it does dry; but the LATENCY CONSEQUENCES of its deferrals are measured against an engine that is NOT actually short of KV. So a positive result says the compound is expressible, fires, and costs what it costs UNDER BELIEVED PRESSURE. It does NOT say the policy helps under real memory pressure. This caveat travels with every rung-4 number, exactly as the driver's own comment requires for the _kv0.5 sweep.

PRE_REGISTERED_PASS_AND_FAILURE.harm_bound: ROBOT LATE AT MOST 10 PER SEED, the same bound used all night, because deferring a rebuild can push the deferred work past its own deadline
